detail.title: CP-UNR-4K6128R16-EI
features: Up to 128 Channels IP camera input
Support 16 SATA HDDs up to 20TB Each, 4 USB Ports
Support Intellicheck with up to 64 Channels
AI by NVR: 8 Channels face detection and recognition, Up to 40 face databases and  300,000 face images, 8 Channels metadata, 32 Channels  perimeter protection, 32 Channels IMD+
AI by Camera: Face detection and recognition, Perimeter  protection, IMD+, Metadata, ANPR, Stereo analysis, Heat  map, and people counting

General.Video Output: 2 VGA, 4 HDMI;                                                                                                                                                             2 VGA: 1920 × 1080, 1280 × 1024, 1280 × 720;                                                                                              4 HDMI 1&2: 3840 × 2160, 1920 × 1080, 1280 × 1024, 1280 × 720; HDMI 3: 7680 × 4320, 3840  × 2160, 1920 × 1080, 1280 × 1024, 1280 × 720; HDMI 4: 1920 × 1080, 1280 × 1024, 1280 × 720  Simultaneous mode (Simultaneously outputs video sources for all the HDMI 1-4 and VGA 1-2  ports) Max. resolution of VGA 1 and VGA 2 is 1080p; Max. resolution of HDMI 1 and HDMI 2 is  4K; Max. resolution of HDMI 3 is 8K; Max. resolution of HDMI 4 is 1080p Heterogeneous mode  (simultaneously outputs video sources for the VGA 1 and HDMI 1, or VGA 2 and HDMI 2. It  also outputs heterogeneous video sources for HDMI 1–4) Max. resolution of VGA 1 and VGA 2  is 1080p; Max. resolution of HDMI 1, HDMI 2 and HDMI 3 is 4K; Max. resolution of HDMI 4 is  1080p
General.AI by Camera: Face detection, Face recognition, Video metadata (Human, Motor vehicles, and non-motor  vehicles), Perimeter protection, IMD, Stereo analysis, Crowd distribution, People counting,  ANPR, Heat map, PPE detection
General.AI by NVR: Face detection, Face recognition, Video metadata (Human, Motor vehicles, and non-motor  vehicles), Perimeter protection, IMD+
General.License Plate Database Capacity: 1. Up to 20,000 plate numbers                                                                                                                          2. Blocklist and allowlist
General.Perimeter Performance AI by NVR: Simultaneous mode: 32 Channels, 10 IVS rules for each channel                                                               Heterogeneous mode: 24 Channels, 10 IVS rules for each channel Refer to the information on  video output for details on the mode
General.IMD+ by NVR: 32 Channels: Secondary filtering for human and motor vehicle, Reducing false alarms caused  by leaves, Rain and lighting condition change
General.Face Detection Performance of AI by NVR: Simultaneous mode: 8 Channels (up to 12 face images/sec each channel)                                                  Heterogeneous mode: 5 Channels (up to 12 face images/sec each channel)                                                    Refer to the information on video output for details on the mode
General.Face Recognition Performance of AI by NV: Simultaneous mode: 32 Channel FD (by camera) + FR (by recorder), Image stream: 32 face  images/sec, 8 Channel FD (by recorder) + FR (by recorder), Video stream: 16 face images/sec             Heterogeneous mode: 16 Channel FD (by camera) + FR (by recorder), Image stream: 16 face  images/sec, 5 Channel FD (by recorder) + FR (by recorder), Video stream: 10 face images/sec  Refer to the information on video output for details on the mode
General.Face Database Capacity: Up to 40 face databases with 300,000 images, with a total capacity of 48G
General.Decoding Capability: AI disabled: 2 Channel 32MP@30 fps, 2 Channel 24MP@30 fps, 4 Channel 16MP@30 fps,              5 Channel 12MP@30 fps, 8 Channel 8MP@30 fps, 11 Channel 6MP@30 fps, 12 Channel  5MP@30 fps, 16 Channel 4MP@30 fps, 32 Channel 1080p@30 fps, 128 Channel D1@30 fps    AI enabled: 1 Channel 32MP@30 fps, 1 Channel 24MP@30 fps, 2 Channel 16MP@30 fps,                    2 Channel 12MP@30 fps, 4 Channel 8MP@30 fps, 5 Channel 6MP@30 fps, 6 Channel  5MP@30 fps, 8 Channel 4MP@30 fps, 16 Channel 1080p@30 fps, 80 Channel D1@30 fps
General.Playback Mode: Instant playback, General playback, Event playback, Tag playback, Smart playback
General.Network Bandwidth: AI disabled: 1280 Mbps incoming, 1280 Mbps recording and 1024 Mbps outgoing                                 AI enabled: 640 Mbps incoming, 640 Mbps recording and 512 Mbps outgoing
General.Intelli check AI by Camera + NVR: Max. 64 Channel, 1 combined event per channel
General.General Alarm: Motion detection, Local alarm, Alarm box, Camera external alarm, Network alarm, Scene  changing, PIR alarm, Thermal alarm
General.Abnormality Alarm: Error (No disk, Disk error, Low space, RAID exception, Low quota space, Abnormal disk health,  Network disconnection, IP conflict, MAC conflict, Abnormal fan speed), Video loss, Video    tampering, Camera offline, Audio detection
General.Intelligent Alarm: Face detection, Face and body detection, Face recognition, Perimeter protection, IMD, Video  metadata, Stereo analysis, Crowd distribution, ANPR, Heat map
General.Alarm Linkage: Record, Snapshot (panoramic), Local alarm output, IPC external alarm output, Access                controller, Audio, Buzzer, Log, Preset, Email
General.Interface Ports: 4 (2 front USB 2.0 ports, 2 rear USB 3.0 ports), 2 RS485 (1 port for half-duplex serial                         communication, 1 port for full-duplex serial communication), 1 RS232, 1 eSATA
General.Protocols: HTTP, HTTPS, TCP/IP, IPv4, IPv6, UDP, SNMP, NTP, DHCP, DNS, SMTP, UPnP, IP Filter, PPPoE,  FTP, DDNS, Alarm Server, Multicast, InstaOn, Auto connect, Iscsi, ONVIF (Profile T, Profile S,  Profile G), CGI, SDK
General.Record Mode: General, Motion detection, Intelligent, Alarm, POS
General.Hard Disk: 16 SATA ports, each disk can contain up to 20 TB. this limit varies depending on the                         environment temperature
